ai_language_tip: Speak clear, polite Standard German (de); dialects (Bavarian/Swabian/Kölsch) understand Hochdeutsch; switch to English only in central Berlin/Munich/Frankfurt if staff offers.
english_ok: sometimes — Common in central Berlin, Munich, Frankfurt, and international hotels, but scarce at doctor offices, trades, and authorities.
politeness: Direct, structured, formal 'Sie'; open with 'Guten Tag' + caller/assistant role ('im Auftrag von Herrn/Frau...'); close with 'Vielen Dank, auf Wiederhören'.
name_tip: Title + surname ('auf den Namen Mustermann') is primary; spell difficult surnames clearly or using German spelling names ('M wie Martha').
phone_tip: Mobile 0151 12345678 or 017x (11–12 digits), landline 030 12345678 (variable length!); say 'zwo' for 2; SMS/email confirmations.
time_tip: CRITICAL: 'halb acht' = 7:30! East/South DE also uses 'viertel acht' = 7:15 and 'dreiviertel acht' = 7:45! Always read back 24-hour ('19 Uhr 30').
number_tip: Say 'zwo' for 2 on phone so 'zwei' isn't heard as 'drei'; note German inverted tens ('vierundzwanzig' = 24).
avoid_calling: Avoid Mittagsruhe 12:30–14:00 at doctors/small offices, restaurant peak 18:30–20:15, calls after 20:00, and Sunday calls for non-hospitality.
closed_days: Strict Sunday retail closure (Sonntagsruhe); many restaurants close Monday or Tuesday (Ruhetag); doctor offices close Wednesday and Friday afternoons; state holidays vary.
booking_channels: Doctolib and Jameda for doctors; OpenTable, TheFork, and Dish/Quandoo for dining; Treatwell for salons; phone still dominant for craftsmen and garages.
voice_menu: Doctor practices increasingly use AI voice assistants (Aaron.ai/Doctolib) or keypad IVR; banks, Telekom, DHL, DB, and Bürgerämter use heavy IVR.
callback_habits: Doctolib and OpenTable send SMS/email reminders; craftsmen and medical AI receptionists (Telefonassistent) take details and call/SMS back.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 德國晚餐普遍在 18:00～20:00 開席，許多傳統餐廳有週一或週二公休日（Ruhetag）且只收現金或德國 Girocard。
usually_asked: Date and arrival time in 24h (Uhrzeit, e.g. 19:00 Uhr)
Number of persons plus child highchair (Kinderstuhl) or dog (Hund)
Surname (auf welchen Namen) and mobile number
Time slot limit if busy weekend

may_come_up.what: Cash only (nur Barzahlung) or EC-Karte only, no credit cards
Outdoor Biergarten tables are walk-in only (keine Reservierung draußen)
Sends OpenTable/online link for large-group card guarantee

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card digits over phone

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 德國診所（Arztpraxis）電話開放時段極窄（常僅早上接聽，週三週五下午休診），且必問「公保或私保（gesetzlich oder privat）」。
usually_asked: Public statutory vs private health insurance (gesetzlich oder privat versichert / Selbstzahler)
Existing patient vs new patient (Bestandspatient oder Neupatient — many have Aufnahmestopp!)
Symptoms, check-up, or referral status (Überweisung vorhanden?)

may_come_up.what: AI phone bot (Telefonassistent) records request for SMS callback
No public-insurance slots for months; offers self-pay (Selbstzahler) or Doctolib

sensitive_asked.what: Asks date of birth (Geburtsdatum — almost always asked!) or Versichertennummer

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 傳統髮廊（Friseur）非常習慣電話預約，都會區美甲與美容亦常用 Treatwell。

may_come_up.what: Cash-only salon policy mentioned
24-hour Ausfallhonorar (no-show fee) policy

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車廠（Kfz-Werkstatt）在 10 月（O bis O）與復活節換胎季極滿；驗車（TÜV/HU）與保養皆可電話預約。
usually_asked: Car make/model and license plate (Kennzeichen), or appliance/phone model
Work needed (Inspektion, HU/AU TÜV, Reifenwechsel, Fehlersuche)
Whether tires are stored at shop (eingelagert)
Morning drop-off time and replacement car (Werkstattersatzwagen)

may_come_up.what: Paid Kostenvoranschlag (estimate fee) if repair declined
Asks HSN/TSN vehicle type code from Fahrzeugschein if special part needed

sensitive_asked.what: Asks phone PIN code over call

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩、希臘菜、亞餐與義大利餐廳普遍接受電話訂自取（zum Mitnehmen / Selbstabholung）到店付。
usually_asked: Menu item numbers (Nummer auf der Karte) and sizes

may_come_up.what: Cash only on pickup
Delivery handled via Lieferando / Wolt only

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 德國獨立書店（隔夜調書極快！）、肉鋪（Metzgerei）、麵包店與藥局（Apotheke 調藥）非常歡迎電話預訂留貨。
usually_asked: Product name, ISBN/PZN code, size, or weight
Pickup day/hour (mind Saturday early closing in small towns)

may_come_up.what: Pharmacy/bookshop orders item for afternoon or next-morning pickup unpaid

sensitive_asked.what: Requests upfront bank transfer for custom order

change.before_dialing_zh: 診所、牙醫與物理治療嚴格執行提前 24 小時取消規定（否則收 Ausfallhonorar 空診費）。

may_come_up.what: Ausfallhonorar fee charged inside 24h cancellation window

sensitive_asked.what: Arztpraxis asks Geburtsdatum (birth date) to verify identity

usually_asked: Question (warme Küche hours, Kartenzahlung, Hund erlaubt, Ruhetag, stock)

may_come_up.what: Restaurant open until 23:00, but warme Küche (hot kitchen) closes at 21:00

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 鄉鎮 Gasthof / Pension 很習慣電話與 Email 訂房；城市連鎖飯店多有語音選單並要求信用卡擔保。
usually_asked: Adults, children, and Doppelzimmer vs Einzelzimmer
Full name, address/email for written Buchungsbestätigung, and phone

may_come_up.what: Kurtaxe (spa/visitor tax) extra; reception closes at 20:00 (Schlüsselsafe for late arrival)
Sends confirmation email requesting card guarantee after 18:00 arrival

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card number over phone

activity.before_dialing_zh: 保齡球道（Kegelbahn/Bowling）、網球場與團體導覽可電話訂，密室與連鎖場館多走網站預付。

may_come_up.what: Directs standard tickets to online shop

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須給完整地址與門鈴姓氏（Klingelschild，德國公寓無房號全靠門鈴名牌！）；工匠（Handwerker）常滿檔數週。
usually_asked: Trade needed (Sanitär/Heizung, Elektriker, Schlüsseldienst, Reinigung, Kammerjäger)
Street, house number, Hinterhof/Vorderhaus, floor, postal code, and name on Klingelschild
Tenant vs homeowner (tenants often need Hausverwaltung approval!)

may_come_up.what: Quotes Anfahrtspauschale (travel flat fee) + hourly rate; emergency Schlüsseldienst night/weekend surcharge
Craftsman asks tenant whether landlord/Hausverwaltung commissioned the repair

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（Tierarzt）、美容（Hundefriseur）與寄宿（Tierpension）皆採預約制，獸醫按 GOT 法定倍數收費。
usually_asked: Species, breed, weight, age, and intact/neutered

may_come_up.what: Emergency/weekend vet charges mandatory GOT emergency fee + higher multiplier

tracking.before_dialing_zh: DHL、Hermes、DPD、UPS 全國專線皆為語音機器人或按鍵選單，僅獨立車廠、乾洗與地方貨運可直撥。

may_come_up.what: DHL/Hermes hotline handled by automated voice bot

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、保險、電力與德國鐵路/漢莎客服皆有語音選單並受 DSGVO（GDPR）嚴格限制須本人核身。

may_come_up.what: DSGVO strictly blocks third party without written Vollmacht on file

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Geburtsdatum, Kundenkennwort, Telefon-PIN, IBAN, or TAN

transport.before_dialing_zh: 德國各地 Taxi-Zentrale、機場接送（Flughafentransfer）與地方租車門市非常習慣電話預訂。
usually_asked: Street, house number, Klingelschild name, and pickup time
Passengers, suitcases, Großraumtaxi (van), or Kindersitz (child seat class!)

may_come_up.what: Taxi-Zentrale uses automated computer voice for repeat callers or queues briefly
Großraumtaxi (5+ pax) surcharge applies

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks Führerschein or credit card number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: ImmoScout24 熱門城市租房多強制站內投遞申請（含 SCHUFA 與薪資單），中小型城市房仲與商用物件仍接電話。
usually_asked: Household size, occupation, net income, and pets

may_come_up.what: Makler accepts inquiries only via ImmoScout24 contact form due to high volume

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政局（Bürgeramt / 115）辦戶籍（Anmeldung）皆須上網搶號且個資受保護；托兒所（Kita）問開放日參觀可打電話。
usually_asked: General requirement question (115 Behördennummer) or Kita info-afternoon
Child age (Krippe <3 vs Elementar 3–6) and Kita-Gutschein status

may_come_up.what: Anmeldung/passport appointments booked online only; Kita places via central Kita-Navigator

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Steuer-ID, Ausweisnummer, or child birth date
